summary: Draganfly Inc. furnished a Form 6-K with a September 9, 2026 press release announcing the appointment of Colonel (Ret'd) Kevin Leblond as Vice-President, Canadian Defence and Security, effective immediately, to lead Canadian military initiatives. Leblond brings 29 years of Royal Canadian Air Force service, including NORAD, NATO and unmanned systems roles. No financial terms, stake, price or ownership change are disclosed. CEO Cameron Chell commented on Canadian defence modernization. The event is a routine executive hire, not a forced CEO/CFO or board departure, and represents neither a special situation nor a capital markets transaction. No arbitrage or deal angle applies.
